content: If a SOME/IP segment is successfully received with the More Segment Flag set to '0', the SOME/IP TP module shall • Cancel the Rx timeout time defined by SomeIpTpRxTimeoutTime. • Call the API PduR_SomeIpTpRxIndication() after it has copied the remaining re- ceived Payload bytes to the upper layer(as defined in SWS_SomeIpTp_00033).
